item.title: Qianjue Unveils Polibrain, a Predictive World Model Built to Run Across Robot Body Types
item.description: Robot-brain developer Qianjue launched Polibrain, a world model that predicts task-relevant state changes instead of future video frames, adapted to quadruped, humanoid and wheeled robots.

item.title: MemTensor Open-Sources MemT 1.0, Memory-Native Models That Keep Long Histories in a Fixed State
item.description: MemTensor released MemT 1.0 Flash and Nano, models with a built-in trainable memory state. It reports about 4x faster inference at 256K history and 130x smaller storage.
